description: September 12 birthday meaning: Virgo decan 2, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a September 12 birthday falls in Virgo, in the second decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Saturn as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Virgo is mutable and earth.

sections.heading: September 12 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Nineteen degrees of Virgo is the closing degree of the Saturn decan, and the 12th of September tends to feel like a hinge between rigour and charm. Twelve reduces to 3, the number of expression, sociability and play. Traditionally this suggests a precise communicator, the friend whose texts are punctuated perfectly and whose jokes land because the timing has been quietly rehearsed.

On September 12 the Sun usually sits at about 19° Virgo, in the second decan, where Saturn is the sub-ruler alongside Mercury. From 10 to 19 degrees of Virgo the sub-ruler is Saturn, which also rules Capricorn. Early-to-mid September birthdays therefore combine Virgo's attention to detail with a serious, long-term sense of responsibility. These natives are frequently described as dependable, disciplined and drawn to work that matters over years rather than weeks. They may carry duties others have dropped, without complaining about it. Saturn can also bring self-doubt and a reluctance to celebrate small wins. Allowing progress to count before it is complete often helps this decan enjoy the sturdy structures it is so good at building.

sections.heading: September 12 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 12th reduces as 1 + 2 = 3, so the birthday number is 3, but the compound holds two stories at once. The 1 brings self-direction and the 2 brings cooperation, and together they produce the 3's expressive, sociable energy. Twelfth-of-the-month natives are often described as communicators who can lead a conversation and also make space for others in it. As with every day number, this is a secondary influence beside the Life Path. Its particular gift tends to be creative work that depends on teamwork, where one voice sets the tone and many voices fill it out.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one September 12 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 2 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example.

sections.heading: Born on September 12: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A September birthday arrives at the turn into autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of new terms and gathering in, and at the start of spring in the southern. Virgo occupies most of the month, with Libra taking over around September 22 or 23, near the equinox. September is month 9 in numerology, the number of completion, compassion and a broad, humanitarian outlook. September 12 is the 255th day of the year (256th in a leap year). By September 23, 11 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Libra.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by September 12, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on September 12 include Irène Joliot-Curie (1897), Stanisław Lem (1921) and Paul Walker (1973).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is September 12?
faq.answer: September 12 is Virgo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Virgo, which tradition links with Saturn.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on September 12?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On September 12 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 2 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 12th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on September 12?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a September 12 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on September 12?
faq.answer: September 12 is also the birthday of Irène Joliot-Curie (1897), Stanisław Lem (1921) and Paul Walker (1973). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
